source.author: cic
source.text: cum eadem et aliis aliter evadant et isdem non semper eodem modo; ut mihi mirum videatur, cum mendaci homini ne verum quidem dicenti credere soleamus, quo modo isti, si somnium verum evasit aliquod, non ex multis potius uni fidem derogent quam ex uno innumerabilia confirment.
source.text_original: cum eadem et aliis aliter evadant et isdem non semper eodem modo; ut mihi mirum videatur, cum mendaci homini ne verum quidem dicenti credere soleamus, quo modo isti, si somnium verum evasit aliquod, non ex multis potius uni fidem derogent quam ex uno innumerabilia confirment.
source.text_english: Since the same things turn out differently for different people and not always in the same way for the same people too, it seems strange to me that, when we usually do not trust a lying man even when he is telling the truth, those people should, if one dream has happened to come true, refuse to trust the many because of one case, rather than confirm countless things because of one.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: mendaces faciunt, ut nec uera dicentibus credatur; quod mihi ego a te obiurgatus de silentio litterarum accidisse uideo.
reuse.text_original: 'mendaces faciunt, ut nec uera dicentibus credatur'; quod mihi ego a te obiurgatus de silentio litterarum accidisse uideo.
reuse.text_english: They act as liars, so that even when people speak truth, they are not believed; and I see that this has happened to me because you have reproached me for my silence in letters.
